name: Donald Sumpter
profileSummary: Donald Sumpter is a British actor who has appeared in film and television since the mid-1960s. His credits include three appearances in Doctor Who, The Black Panther (1977), Bleak House (1985), The Queen's Nose (1995–1998), Great Expectations (1999), Nicholas Nickleby (2001), Enigma (2001), K-19: The Widowmaker (2002), The Constant Gardener (2005), Being Human (2009–2010), Ultramarines: The Movie (2010), Black Mirror (2011), Game of Thrones (2011–2012), Endeavour (2018), Les Misérables (2018), Chernobyl (2019), and The Phoenician Scheme (2025).
